Select molecule_chembl_id aliased as compound_chembl_id and canonical_smiles for molecules tested against human histone deacetylase 6. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, assays, and target_dictionary, matching target_dictionary.pref_name to 'histone deacetylase 6' and target_dictionary.organism to 'Homo sapiens'. Inner join compound_structures to require canonical_smiles. Return rows sorted by compound_chembl_id.
